text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has identified that the current compulsory stop by-law for Sorauren Avenue and Marion Street is inconsistent with the installed signage. To address this discrepancy, we are recommending a housekeeping amendment to align the by-law with the existing field conditions.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing compulsory stop control for northbound and southbound traffic on Sorauren Avenue at Marion Street. 2. Authorized a compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Marion Street at Sorauren Avenue.
